description: Tracked phase-entry document refs for ForgeKit agents. Load only the current phase's required refs and matching conditional refs.

conditions.production_code: Production-facing code, scripts, templates, or runtime-facing configuration changed.
conditions.public_api: External contract changed: HTTP/RPC API, SDK signature, CLI flag, event schema, or documented integration surface.
conditions.data_migration: Database schema, backfill, migration, destructive data operation, or persisted data shape changed.
conditions.deploy_change: Deployment, CI/CD, infrastructure, environment variable, secret, rollout, or observability configuration changed.
conditions.figma_or_design: Task includes a Figma/design source, UI implementation from design, or design QA.
